child.label: Couple Life & Plans
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a story about everyday life in a dating relationship: chores, money, time together, holidays, trips, habits, and plans like moving in or marrying.
child.not_for: Stories about jealousy, cheating or a partner's friends of the opposite sex (use Jealousy & Cheating); about breaking up or an ex (use Breakups & Exes); married couples (use Spouses & Married Life).
examples: AITA for wanting my boyfriend to clean his side of the room?
AITA for not wanting my girlfriend's best friend on our holiday?
AITA for not wanting to split an expensive hotel with my partner?

child.label: Jealousy & Cheating
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a story about cheating, suspected infidelity, jealousy, or a partner's closeness to other people they might be attracted to.
child.not_for: Everyday couple disagreements with no jealousy or infidelity (use Couple Life & Plans); stories centered on ending the relationship or an ex (use Breakups & Exes).
examples: AITA for going to a movie with a female coworker?
AITA for telling my girlfriend I'm uncomfortable with some of her IG friends?

child.label: Breakups & Exes
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a story about deciding to break up, how a breakup was handled, or dealing with an ex afterwards.
child.not_for: Stories where a couple is still together and the conflict is day-to-day (use Couple Life & Plans); stories about cheating that do not center on the breakup (use Jealousy & Cheating).
examples: AITA for dumping my girlfriend because she bullied a disabled kid?
AITA for making my ex cry?
AITA for wanting to break up with my bf for not upholding our agreement?
